title: MFCC Heatmap
caption: The 13 mel-frequency cepstral coefficients over the first 6 seconds of D1_training-e_e02008 (PhysioNet 2016, 17.6 s). c0 (frame log-energy) and c1 (spectral slope) are drawn as lines rather than heatmap rows: their ranges sit tens of dB away from c2-c12, and either one inside the shared colour scale flattens every other coefficient into a uniform block. All 13 are shown because the feature vector uses all 13. The mel spectrogram uses an ABSOLUTE dB reference (ref=1.0, top_db=None), not librosa's default, which clips 80 dB below each record's own maximum and would normalise every record against itself inside a feature meant to be compared across records.
command: python scripts/19_data_graphs.py --figures G01 G02 G03 G04 G05 G06 G07 G08 G09 G10
